cohort: Fixed 25 candidates in the prior PS1 standardized derivative manifest

quality_policy.common: Exact decimal Gaia association plus proper-motion corrected position; no colour residual cut.
quality_policy.skymapper: At least two good exposures, all included source flags and masked-pixel counts zero, PSF-neighbour bit clear.
quality_policy.jplus: At least two exposures, source/mask/tile/known-variability flags zero, single-band detection present, relative weight >=0.8.
quality_policy.zeropoints: SkyMapper: catalogue error unchanged. J-PLUS: abs_zp_offset_err added in quadrature as instructed; published offsets already applied.

limitations: Different source photons do not imply independent zero-point calibration.
Both surveys use Gaia XP calibration stars; J-PLUS also uses a WD locus and PS1 r global anchor.
Quoted/error-box constraints are not independent Gaussian confidence regions.
Survey absence and magnitude sentinel 99 are not quantitative flux upper limits.
Catalogue flags and aperture comparisons do not substitute for an image-level PSF contamination model.
Passband coverage and synthetic photometry are evaluated separately; no extrapolation is done here.
